title: Tactile 0.60 全链路并发安全加固、菜单栏剪贴板历史与字符/轻点手势精调

notes.zh:
Tactile 0.60 重点更新：
• 核心引擎并发与稳定性深度加固：全面迁移至 macOS 14+ OSAllocatedUnfairLock，修复多点触控停启死锁、休眠唤醒时间戳回退、多触控板掌压串扰及跨线程数据竞争等 13 项核心缺陷
• 菜单栏增强与剪贴板历史子菜单：新增菜单栏快捷功能开关、最近 12 条剪贴板历史（含图片缩略图与一键直接粘贴）以及同步快捷键的悬浮菜单 / 截屏入口
• 字符绘制与单指驻留轻点人体工学调优：防止双指捏合误判与微漂移中断字符笔触，大幅提升弯指与触控板下沿拇指轻点的识别率
• 120Hz 物理仿真测试体系：新增 82 项全链路手势仿真用例并全部通过
• 包含 Apple Silicon (arm64)、Intel (x86_64) 原生独立版及 Universal 2 通用二进制，均通过 Developer ID 权威签名
notes.en:
Tactile 0.60 Highlights:
• Core engine concurrency & stability hardening: migrated locks to OSAllocatedUnfairLock for Swift 6 strict safety, fixing 13 core issues including stop deadlock, sleep/wake timestamp rollback, multi-trackpad palm isolation, and cross-thread data races
• Menu bar & Clipboard History submenu: added quick enhancement toggles, 12-item Clipboard History with thumbnail previews and direct paste, plus shortcut-synced Floating Menu and Screenshot launchers
• Character drawing & One-Fix Tap ergonomics: prevented premature stroke cancellation from pinch-zoom false positives and improved curved-finger & bottom-edge thumb tap sensitivity
• 120Hz physics gesture simulation suite: 82/82 end-to-end tests passing across Trackpad, Character/Stroke, Magic Mouse, and Robustness
• Signed with Developer ID as Universal 2, Apple Silicon, and Intel standalone packages
